findings.title: Missing @idempotent decorator on money-moving endpoint
findings.explanation: ADR-004 requires @idempotent decorator on all money-moving POST endpoints (refunds, charges, captures, payouts, transfers) to prevent duplicate operations from client retries. This endpoint refunds money and debits a fee, making it money-moving.
findings.recommendation: Add @idempotent decorator to refund_remaining_with_fee handler, requiring Idempotency-Key header. Handler should return 400 if key is missing.

findings.title: Direct httpx.Client construction violates ADR-006
findings.explanation: ADR-006 requires all outbound HTTP use app.clients.http.make_client(service_name), which provides 3s connect/10s read timeouts, 2 retries with jittered backoff, request-id propagation, and metrics. Direct httpx.Client construction bypasses this infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Replace direct httpx.Client with make_client('bank-transfers'). Create app/clients/bank_transfers.py module wrapping the client if needed for reuse.

findings.title: Service raises HTTP exception instead of domain error
findings.explanation: raise_for_status() raises httpx.HTTPStatusError, not a domain error. Services are called from workers, jobs, and CLI where HTTP exceptions are meaningless; only API layer should deal with HTTP status codes.
findings.recommendation: Check response.status_code and raise appropriate domain error (e.g., errors.ProviderUnavailable for 5xx, errors.Conflict for 4xx). Let API layer map domain errors to HTTP responses.

findings.title: Fee calculated on wrong amount
findings.explanation: Pricing sheet v4 specifies 1.5% of the refunded amount, but fee is calculated on charge.amount_cents (original charge) instead of refund.amount_cents (what's actually being refunded). If a charge was partially refunded, the fee would be based on the original amount, not the remaining refunded amount.
findings.recommendation: Change _processing_fee(charge.amount_cents) to _processing_fee(refund.amount_cents) to calculate fee on the actual refunded amount as specified in pricing sheet v4.
